One-shot authorization marker for the capped Hideki testnet BTC position round-trip.

Safety bounds are enforced by scripts/run-funded-position-roundtrip.ts:
- Hideki testnet chain ID 50383 only
- Existing positions or BTC orders stop the run before funding/trading
- At most 5 USDso margin top-up if unlocked margin is below 5
- One BTC long MARKET order, target 12 USDso and hard cap 15 USDso
- Immediate close attempt and post-run flat-state verification
- No voucher claim; wallet key never printed or stored

This file exists only to trigger one authorized run. Do not edit it again.
